title: DNA Extraction from Symbiodinium Cultures
author: Tingting Xiang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qhbdt2n

steps.title: Grow Symbiodinium culture
steps.instruction: Cultivate Symbiodinium cells in IMK or IMK + casein hydrolysate medium until mid‑log phase, aiming for a cell density of approximately 1 × 10⁶ cells · mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Harvest cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin the culture at 1 000 g, room temperature, for 5 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare 1X lysis buffer
steps.instruction: If the 2X lysis buffer has precipitated, warm it, then dilute 1 : 1 with water to obtain 1X buffer; use ~500 µL of 1X buffer per 1 × 10⁶ cells and scale the volume according to the number of samples.

steps.title: Lyse cells with phenol‑chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL 1X lysis buffer to the cell pellet, then add 500 µL Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1) and mix by inverting a few times.

steps.title: First phase separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 13 000 g for 5 min, then transfer the upper aqueous layer to a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL RNase A (20 mg · mL⁻¹) to the aqueous phase and incubate for 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1), invert a few times, and recover the clean upper layer without disturbing the interphase; if protein contamination remains, repeat extraction with Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) as needed.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) and invert a few times.
Centrifuge at 13 000 g, room temperature, for 5 min.
Transfer the upper aqueous layer to a fresh 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation of DNA
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 volumes of absolute ethanol to the aqueous phase and incubate either on ice for 30 min or at –20 °C overnight.

steps.title: Pellet DNA by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 13 000 g, room temperature, for 20 min to pellet the DNA.

steps.title: Wash DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and wash the pellet once with 1 mL 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Dry and resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet briefly, then resuspend it in 50 µL sterile H₂O and vortex at room temperature until fully dissolved.

steps.title: Quantify and assess DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a NanoDrop spectrophotometer and load ~1 µL on a 1 % agarose gel for electrophoretic quality check.
